decision.title: JSON texts are parsed with tree-sitter (packet )
decision.summary: JSON texts are parsed with the strict RFC 8259 tree-sitter grammar grammars/json and one loop over a tree cursor, serving fn:parse-json, json-to-xml, xml-to-json, jtree and parse-xml, plus adaptive output.

body.p: . fn:parse-json and fn:json-to-xml parse with a tree-sitter grammar, grammars/json (strict RFC 8259, original work), not with a hand-written parser; applies without exception. Weighed against 's reasons for regexes: (1) JSON is run-time data and tree-sitter allocates with malloc outside sxml's allocators and limits, but fn:parse-xml already parses run-time data this way (), so that alone is no exception; (2) unlike a regex, JSON is context-free with context-free tokens: no flags change the lexing, no back-references, so the grammar is complete and the walk adds only what a grammar cannot say (surrogate pairing, permitted characters, duplicates, numbers); (3) FOJS0001 is one code, and the walk reports the line and column of the first ERROR or MISSING node in the description. The cost: the concrete syntax tree is held while the walk builds values (several times the text in memory), and U+0000 is refused before parsing (tree-sitter would read it as the end; RFC 8259 forbids it unescaped). The walk is one loop over a tree cursor () that sends JSON events to a sink: one sink makes maps, arrays and atomic items on explicit stacks, the other sends tree builder events. src/json_internal.h is the interface.

item.p: Functions (src/function_library_json.c, part sxml_function_library_json): fn:parse-json, json-to-xml, xml-to-json, jtree, parse-xml. Options follow F&O 4.0, 1.7: unknown string keys XPTY0004, QName keys with a namespace ignored, values coerced (sxml_evaluator_coerce), bad values FOJS0005; liberal accepts nothing beyond RFC 8259. Characters an escape gives that xs:string cannot hold (U+0000, unpaired surrogates, U+FFFE/FFFF) become U+FFFD; a fallback function is UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE for now (it needs a resumable body). json-to-xml: untyped tree in heap memory that destroys itself, default namespace on the outer element, validate=true FOJS0004. xml-to-json: FOJS0006 checks without a schema, duplicate normalized keys through a hash index, indent adds nothing. parse-xml: through the document loader (); xs:string as UTF-8, binary values as their octets (the string's encoding declaration is not ignored yet); dtd-validation, xinclude, strip-space="all" FODC0013, xsd-validation other than skip FODC0009.

Adaptive output (src/serialize.c): frames on a heap stack (); strings in double quotes with quotes doubled, also at the top level; xs:double as mantissa and exponent (1.0e0), other non-string, non-decimal types and non-finite doubles as xs:TYPE("value"); QNames #prefix:local (array fn map math xs) or #Q{uri}local; anonymous functions (anonymous-function)#N; nodes by the XML method without a declaration, each element declaring the in-scope namespaces its written parent lacks; JNodes jtree(V) / jnode(K:V).
Root CMakeLists.txt links sxml_grammar_json (one line, 1.0's file).
